preconditions.description: The jumble must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in dictionary)
preconditions.description: All words in the dictionary must be strings.

postconditions.description: The return value must be a list.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(word, str) for word in return_value)
postconditions.description: All elements in the return list must be strings.

postconditions.expression: return_value == [word for word in dictionary if sorted(jumble) == sorted(word)]
postconditions.description: The return list must contain words from the dictionary that can be formed by rearranging the letters of the jumble.
